premise: Acorn wishes to fly like Butterfly; she climbs onto Mushroom's cap, flaps her little arms and wishes hard — then a breeze makes Mushroom sneeze, ACHOO, Acorn tumbles off into the grass, and she's sure she flew. Butterfly agrees.
inspiration: Icarus and every folk tale of wanting to fly, turned: a gentle tumble, a sneeze for wings, and a friend who says yes.
lesson: Trying is its own kind of flying.

en-US.title: Acorn Wants to Fly
en-US.text: {butterfly:enter} Butterfly was flitting over the meadow, and little {acorn:enter} Acorn watched her go. {acorn:face sad} [sighs] "I wish I could fly," she said. {butterfly:go to meadow} Butterfly fluttered down into the grass. "Then climb up high and try!" she said, and {butterfly:live rest hold} folded her wings to watch. Up popped {mushroom:enter} Mushroom. [excited] "Climb on me!" {acorn:go on mushroom} Up scrambled Acorn, onto the red cap. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:live flap-arms} She flapped her little arms. Flap, flap, flap! Nothing. {acorn:live wish hold} So she squeezed her eyes tight and wished. [whispers] "Please… just one little flight…" {canvas:wind 0.6 8s} Just then, a breeze tickled Mushroom. {mushroom:live sneeze} Ah… ah… {sfx:achoo} ACHOO! {acorn:go to meadow right} {acorn:spin} Off the cap flew Acorn — up, round and round, and down into the soft grass. {sfx:plop} Plop! {acorn:live wish resume} She opened her eyes. [gasps] "I FLEW!" {mushroom:face surprised} "Well," said Mushroom, "sort of." {butterfly:live rest resume} Butterfly opened her wings and fluttered them. {butterfly:live talk} [warmly] "You flew," she said. "Beautifully." {acorn:face happy} {acorn:hop x3} "Again!" cried Acorn. And Mushroom promised to save her another sneeze.

es-ES.title: Bellota quiere volar
es-ES.text: {butterfly:enter} Mariposa revoloteaba por el prado, y la pequeña {acorn:enter} Bellota la seguía con la mirada. {acorn:face sad} [sighs] —Ojalá yo pudiera volar —suspiró. {butterfly:go to meadow} Mariposa bajó a posarse en la hierba. —¡Pues súbete a algo alto y prueba! —le dijo, y {butterfly:live rest hold} cerró las alas para mirar. Entonces asomó {mushroom:enter} Seta. [excited] —¡Súbete a mí! {acorn:go on mushroom} Bellota trepó hasta lo alto del sombrero rojo. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:live flap-arms} Y movió los bracitos: ¡arriba, abajo, arriba, abajo! Nada de nada. {acorn:live wish hold} Así que apretó los ojos y pidió un deseo. [whispers] —Por favor… un vuelito, solo uno… {canvas:wind 0.6 8s} Justo entonces, una brisa le hizo cosquillas a Seta. {mushroom:live sneeze} Aaa… aaa… {sfx:achoo} ¡ACHÍS! {acorn:go to meadow right} {acorn:spin} Bellota salió disparada del sombrero: para arriba, vuelta y vuelta, y para abajo, a la hierba blandita. {sfx:plop} ¡Plof! {acorn:live wish resume} Abrió los ojos. [gasps] —¡HE VOLADO! {mushroom:face surprised} —Bueno —dijo Seta—, más o menos. {butterfly:live rest resume} Mariposa abrió las alas y las agitó. {butterfly:live talk} [warmly] —Has volado —dijo—. Y muy bien. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:hop x3} —¡Otra vez! —gritó Bellota. Y Seta le prometió guardarle otro estornudo.

ja-JP.title: どんぐり、そらをとびたい
ja-JP.text: {butterfly:enter}チョウチョさんが、はらっぱをひらひら。小さな{acorn:enter}どんぐりが、じっと見ています。{acorn:face sad}[sighs]「わたしも、とべたらいいのに。」 {butterfly:go to meadow}チョウチョさんが、くさにおりてきました。「じゃあ、高いところからやってごらん！」 そういって、{butterfly:live rest hold}はねをとじて見まもります。ひょっこり{mushroom:enter}キノコが出てきました。[excited]「わたしにのって！」 {acorn:go on mushroom}どんぐりは、赤いかさによじのぼって、{acorn:face happy}{acorn:live flap-arms}小さなうでを、ぱたぱたぱた！…なんにもおこりません。{acorn:live wish hold}目をぎゅっとつぶって…[whispers]「どうか、ちょっとだけ、とばせて…」 {canvas:wind 0.6 8s}そのとき、そよかぜがキノコをくすぐりました。{mushroom:live sneeze}は…は…{sfx:achoo}はっくしょん！{acorn:go to meadow right}{acorn:spin}どんぐりは、かさからぴゅーん！くるくるまわって、やわらかいくさの上へ。{sfx:plop}ぽてっ！{acorn:live wish resume}目をあけると…[gasps]「とべた！」 {mushroom:face surprised}「まあ、いちおうね」 とキノコ。{butterfly:live rest resume}チョウチョさんが、はねをひらいてひらひら。{butterfly:live talk}[warmly]「とべたわよ。とってもすてきに。」 {acorn:face happy}{acorn:hop x3}「もういっかい！」 キノコは、つぎのくしゃみもとっておくね、とやくそくしました。

de-DE.title: Die Eichel will fliegen
de-DE.text: {butterfly:enter} Der Schmetterling tanzte über die Wiese, und {acorn:enter} die kleine Eichel sah ihm nach. {acorn:face sad} [sighs] „Ich wünschte, ich könnte fliegen“, seufzte sie. {butterfly:go to meadow} Der Schmetterling flatterte hinunter ins Gras. „Dann kletter ganz hoch und probier’s!“, sagte er und {butterfly:live rest hold} klappte die Flügel zusammen, um zuzuschauen. Da ploppte {mushroom:enter} der Pilz aus dem Boden. [excited] „Kletter auf mich!“ {acorn:go on mushroom} Schwupp, schon krabbelte die Eichel auf den roten Hut. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:live flap-arms} Sie schlug mit ihren Ärmchen. Flatter, flatter, flatter! Nichts. {acorn:live wish hold} Also kniff sie die Augen zu und wünschte sich etwas. [whispers] „Bitte… nur ein ganz kleiner Flug…“ {canvas:wind 0.6 8s} Da kitzelte ein Windhauch den Pilz. {mushroom:live sneeze} Ha… ha… {sfx:achoo} HATSCHI! {acorn:go to meadow right} {acorn:spin} Die Eichel flog vom Hut – hinauf, rundherum, rundherum und hinunter ins weiche Gras. {sfx:plop} Plumps! {acorn:live wish resume} Sie machte die Augen auf. [gasps] „Ich bin GEFLOGEN!“ {mushroom:face surprised} „Na ja“, sagte der Pilz, „so ungefähr.“ {butterfly:live rest resume} Der Schmetterling öffnete die Flügel und flatterte. {butterfly:live talk} [warmly] „Du bist geflogen“, sagte er. „Wunderschön.“ {acorn:face happy} {acorn:hop x3} „Nochmal!“, rief die Eichel. Und der Pilz versprach, ihr noch einen Nieser aufzuheben.

fr-FR.title: Gland veut voler
fr-FR.text: {butterfly:enter} Papillon voletait au-dessus du pré, et le petit {acorn:enter} Gland le regardait. {acorn:face sad} [sighs] « Si seulement je pouvais voler… » a-t-il soupiré. {butterfly:go to meadow} Papillon s’est posé dans l’herbe : « Alors grimpe tout en haut et essaie ! » Et {butterfly:live rest hold} il a replié ses ailes pour regarder. Et hop, {mushroom:enter} Champignon a surgi ! [excited] « Grimpe sur moi ! » {acorn:go on mushroom} Gland a escaladé son chapeau rouge. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:live flap-arms} Il a battu de ses petits bras. Flap, flap, flap ! Rien. {acorn:live wish hold} Alors il a fermé les yeux et fait un vœu. [whispers] « S’il vous plaît… rien qu’un tout petit vol… » {canvas:wind 0.6 8s} Juste alors, une brise a chatouillé Champignon. {mushroom:live sneeze} Ah… ah… {sfx:achoo} ATCHOUM ! {acorn:go to meadow right} {acorn:spin} Gland s’est envolé du chapeau — en haut, en rond, et en bas, dans l’herbe douce. {sfx:plop} Pouf ! {acorn:live wish resume} Il a ouvert les yeux. [gasps] « J’ai VOLÉ ! » {mushroom:face surprised} « Enfin, a dit Champignon, un peu. » {butterfly:live rest resume} Papillon a ouvert grand ses ailes. {butterfly:live talk} [warmly] « Tu as volé, a-t-il dit. Et drôlement bien. » {acorn:face happy} {acorn:hop x3} « Encore ! » a crié Gland. Et Champignon a promis de lui garder un autre éternuement.

it-IT.title: Ghianda vuole volare
it-IT.text: {butterfly:enter} Farfalla svolazzava sopra il prato, e la piccola {acorn:enter} Ghianda la guardava volare. {acorn:face sad} [sighs] «Come vorrei volare anch'io», ha detto. {butterfly:go to meadow} Farfalla si è posata giù nell'erba. «Allora sali in alto e prova!» le ha detto, e {butterfly:live rest hold} ha chiuso le ali per guardarla. Ed ecco spuntare {mushroom:enter} Fungo. [excited] «Sali su di me!» {acorn:go on mushroom} Ghianda si è arrampicata fin sul cappello rosso. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:live flap-arms} Ha sbattuto le braccine. Su e giù, su e giù! Niente. {acorn:live wish hold} Allora ha stretto forte gli occhi e ha espresso un desiderio. [whispers] «Ti prego… solo un voletto piccino…» {canvas:wind 0.6 8s} Proprio in quel momento, una brezza ha fatto il solletico a Fungo. {mushroom:live sneeze} Ah… ah… {sfx:achoo} ETCIÙ! {acorn:go to meadow right} {acorn:spin} Ghianda è volata via dal cappello: su in alto, giro giro tondo… e giù per terra, nell'erba morbida. {sfx:plop} Pof! {acorn:live wish resume} Ha aperto gli occhi. [gasps] «Ho VOLATO!» {mushroom:face surprised} «Be'», ha detto Fungo, «più o meno.» {butterfly:live rest resume} Farfalla ha aperto le ali e le ha fatte frullare. {butterfly:live talk} [warmly] «Hai volato», ha detto. «E benissimo.» {acorn:face happy} {acorn:hop x3} «Ancora!» ha gridato Ghianda. E Fungo le ha promesso di tenerle da parte un altro starnuto.

zh-TW.title: 橡實想要飛
zh-TW.text: {butterfly:enter}蝴蝶在草地上飛呀飛，小小的{acorn:enter}橡實一直望著牠。{acorn:face sad}[sighs]「要是我也會飛，那該有多好。」 {butterfly:go to meadow}蝴蝶輕輕落進草叢裡。「那就爬到高高的地方試試看！」 牠說完，{butterfly:live rest hold}合起翅膀，在一旁看著。{mushroom:enter}蘑菇冒了出來。[excited]「爬到我身上來！」 {acorn:go on mushroom}橡實爬呀爬，爬上了紅紅的菇傘。{acorn:face happy}{acorn:live flap-arms}她揮動小手臂，拍拍拍、拍拍拍！什麼也沒發生。{acorn:live wish hold}於是她緊緊閉上眼睛，許了一個願。[whispers]「拜託……讓我飛一下下就好……」 {canvas:wind 0.6 8s}這時候，一陣微風吹過來，搔得蘑菇好癢。{mushroom:live sneeze}哈……哈……{sfx:achoo}哈啾！{acorn:go to meadow right}{acorn:spin}橡實從菇傘上飛了出去，往上飛，轉呀轉，再落進軟綿綿的草地裡。{sfx:plop}咚！{acorn:live wish resume}她睜開眼睛。[gasps]「我飛起來了！」 {mushroom:face surprised}「嗯……」 蘑菇說，「算是吧。」 {butterfly:live rest resume}蝴蝶張開翅膀，輕輕搧了搧。{butterfly:live talk}[warmly]「你飛起來了，」 牠說，「飛得好漂亮。」 {acorn:face happy}{acorn:hop x3}「再一次！」 橡實大叫。蘑菇答應她，下一個噴嚏也留給她。

zh-HK.title: 橡實想飛
zh-HK.text: {butterfly:enter}蝴蝶在草地上飛來飛去，小小的{acorn:enter}橡實一直望着牠。{acorn:face sad}[sighs]「如果我識飛就好喇。」 她說。{butterfly:go to meadow}蝴蝶輕輕落在草叢裏。「咁就爬上高啲，試吓啦！」 牠說完，{butterfly:live rest hold}就合起翅膀，在一旁看着。{mushroom:enter}蘑菇從地上冒了出來。[excited]「爬上嚟我度啦！」 {acorn:go on mushroom}橡實手腳並用，爬上了紅色的蘑菇帽。{acorn:face happy}{acorn:live flap-arms}她拍動小手臂，拍拍拍、拍拍拍！還是飛不起來。{acorn:live wish hold}於是她緊緊閉上眼睛，許了一個願。[whispers]「拜託……畀我飛一陣就得……」 {canvas:wind 0.6 8s}就在這時，一陣微風吹過，搔得蘑菇癢癢的。{mushroom:live sneeze}哈……哈……{sfx:achoo}乞嗤！{acorn:go to meadow right}{acorn:spin}橡實從蘑菇帽上彈了出去，向上飛，轉呀轉，再落在軟綿綿的草地上。{sfx:plop}噗！{acorn:live wish resume}她張開眼睛。[gasps]「我飛咗呀！」 {mushroom:face surprised}「嗯……」 蘑菇說，「都算係啩。」 {butterfly:live rest resume}蝴蝶張開翅膀，輕輕拍了拍。{butterfly:live talk}[warmly]「你真係飛咗，」 牠說，「仲飛得好靚添。」 {acorn:face happy}{acorn:hop x3}「再嚟多次！」 橡實大叫。蘑菇答應她，下一個噴嚏，一定留給她。

achoo.prompt: a tiny, cute comic sneeze, achoo, with a soft puff of air after it, playful

plop.prompt: a tiny acorn landing softly in thick grass, a light comic plop, playful
